Thanks Sean — dug into the packets over the weekend and did a short score write-up in the matrix. TL;DR: Horizon PR comes out on top for senior media relationships in SF/LA and trade press; they proposed a flexible on-site staffing model that fits our event cadence.

Notes:
- Horizon (Samira) can staff two SR leads + 1 on-site producer for both events; they’ll bring biotech contacts and a trade reporter list (good fit).
- Proposed fees (from packet): $28k/mo retainer but they offered a 10% discount if we commit to a 3-month block.
- They are open to carving event fees into a separate line item (so we can budget under events pool rather than core retainer).
- I redlined the SOW where scope is vague: media training deliverables, post-event coverage reporting cadence, and IP ownership for press materials. See attachment: Horizon_SOW_redlines.docx.

Risks / asks:
- They did not include travel caps — suggest we cap cross-country travel per event at $6k unless pre-approved.
- Need procurement to confirm whether we can use a combined PO for retainer+event fees or separate POs.

Recommendation: start with Horizon on a 3-month pilot (Sept–Nov) at discounted retainer, scope the launch and partner summit as separate event line items. If we get good pickup we convert to quarterly retainer.

Happy to discuss 2pm Tuesday.

—Marissa
